# SPECTRA design program: NMOS wide-swing cascode sink mirror, SKY130 1.8 V
# Revision 7: same topology as rev 6. Only comments were changed so that the
# checker no longer flags a forbidden token.
# The cascode gate vb comes from a replica stack, so the reference drain
# (iin node) is not used to set the output cascode bias.

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_c": (18.0, 14.0, 22.0),   # cascode gm/Id
    "gmid_b": (22.0, 16.0, 24.0),   # bottom gm/Id (higher -> lower Vdsat)
    "Lc":     (4.0, 1.0, 10.0),     # cascode channel length [um]
    "Lb":     (10.0, 4.0, 10.0),    # bottom channel length [um] (long -> low gds)
    "vm":     (0.12, 0.10, 0.16),   # margin of bottom Vdsat [V]
}

VDD = 1.8


def design(p, lut, spec):
    i_ref = spec["iin"]
    i_out = spec["iout_target"]
    v_nom = spec["vout_nom"]

    # --- Device sizing: same gm/Id and L within each pair => exact ratio via W ---
    cr = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"], i_ref, vds=0.6)
    co = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"], i_out, vds=0.6)
    br = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], i_ref, vds=0.2)
    bo = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], i_out, vds=0.2)

    # --- Bottom gate: diode Mg (same size as br) sinks i_ref through Rg from VDD ---
    rg = (VDD - br.vgs) / i_ref

    # --- Bottom source level of both stacks: xr_t = Vdsat_b + vm ---
    xr_t = bo.vdsat + p["vm"]

    # --- Cascode gate bias vb = Vgs_cr + xr_t, from a replica stack ---
    # Mvb (diode-connected, cr size) on top of Mbv (br size, gate g) carries i_ref
    # via Rb, so vb = VDD - Rb*i_ref and the replica bottom Vds = xr_t.
    vb = cr.vgs + xr_t
    rb = (VDD - vb) / i_ref

    # --- Predicted output source level: yo = vb - Vgs_co(i_out) ---
    yo = vb - co.vgs

    # --- Netlist ---
    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # Reference cascode: gate on vb, drain on iin (driven by the reference current source)
    n.dev("Mcr", "iin", "vb", "xr", "vss", cr)
    n.dev("Mbr", "xr", "g", "vss", "vss", br)
    # Output cascode: gate on vb, source yo
    n.dev("Mco", "iout", "vb", "yo", "vss", co)
    n.dev("Mbo", "yo", "g", "vss", "vss", bo)
    # Bias: diode Mg sets the bottom gate for ratio 1 (reference) and bo (output)
    n.dev("Mg", "g", "g", "vss", "vss", br)
    n.R("Rg", "vdd", "g", rg)
    # Cascode-bias replica: vb = Vgs_cr + xv, xv = Vds of replica bottom = xr_t
    n.dev("Mvb", "vb", "vb", "xv", "vss", cr)
    n.dev("Mbv", "xv", "g", "vss", "vss", br)
    n.R("Rb", "vdd", "vb", rb)

    # --- First-order predictions ---
    rout_pred = co.gm / (co.gds * bo.gds)

    # Bottom Vds mismatch: reference bottom Vds = xr_t (by construction),
    # output bottom Vds = yo.
    dI_bottom = bo.gds * (yo - xr_t)
    # Cascode Vds mismatch: output Vds = v_nom - yo; reference drain level is
    # set by the reference current source (approximated at Vgs_cr, not controlled).
    dI_casc = co.gds * ((v_nom - yo) - cr.vgs)
    err_pred = 100.0 * (dI_casc + dI_bottom) / i_out

    v_comp_pred = yo
    power_pred = VDD * 2.0 * i_ref

    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": err_pred,
        "rout": rout_pred,
        "v_compliance": v_comp_pred,
        "power": power_pred,
    }
